top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov; GLP-1 physiology and its active forms) is a complete, decades-replicated discovery chain, confirmed in large independent randomized trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The citation is scoped to discoveries and does not claim the drugs. The Mojsov versus Habener priority question is unresolved but not refuted, and the Knudsen exclusion is a real cost of the three-laureate cap. Neither outweighs the case, so I prefer awarding this prize to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my documented co-authorships (e.g. Sandberg, Betsholtz, Frisen, Lundeberg) and spatial transcriptomics work do not involve the incretin candidates
